counting_notes: These are architecture and workload specifications, not measured FLOP counts.
FLOP estimates depend on whether multiply-add counts as two operations and whether attention is counted over a full square or a causal triangle.
Training performs forward and backward passes. Optimizer updates, validation, and evaluation are separate workloads.
Native inference with targets=None applies the vocabulary head only at the last position; training and full-token scoring apply it at every position.
Inference cost depends on input length, output length, and KV-cache policy.
Tensor stacking and memory traffic contribute to elapsed time without necessarily adding many floating-point operations.
